title: Meidum pyramid as collapsed test structure

tellings.quote: We then have intermediary structures like the pyramid of my doom in the fume oasis which was a test structure that was designed to model and implement the same physics and chemistry as the red pyramid. There was a catastrophic collapse.

plain: A researcher named Geoffrey Drumm, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, talks about the pyramid at Meidum, in the Faiyum oasis area of Egypt. Drumm says it was a test building, meant to try out the same physics and chemistry as a later pyramid known as the Red Pyramid, and that it suffered a catastrophic collapse. If he is right, the great pyramids were built as working machines, with Meidum as a failed prototype.
